name: parallel-branches-rr-v1
description: Promise.all of two branches, each branch two synchronous ctx.run calls. The first turn emits Run a1, Run b1 then two proposals, suspending on FIRST(1, 2) — every proposal of the turn. The next turn delivers the RunCompletions in journal order: branch a goes on (Run a2 + proposal) first, then branch b; the command sequence is a function of the journal.
